question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58e8f588d34e6071ae33823d8abf0c0459e3279e464f6756a5e2e7477be237e6.png]
solution: The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below: 1) Total triangles = [Number of parts × (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2 = [2 × (1 + 2)] ÷ 2 = [2 × 3] ÷ 2 = 6 ÷ 2 = 3
